newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks open up as buying continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks open up as buying continues.

text.p: Dhaka stocks opened up on Monday as buyers, ignoring nationwide tension over an advancing storm into coastal areas, maintained buying interest during early trade on Monday, brokers said.
"Besides retailers and institutions, some big private firms are buying bulk volume through brokers. Most scrips are gaining," said one broker.

Bangladesh Lamps gained 165 to 5,100 and Apex Tannery was up 55 to 700. The Dhaka Stock Exchange index closed 44.88 points up at 1,189.46 on turnover of 87.6 million taka on Saturday. Sunday was a public holiday.
